Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Rachael Haynes and Alyssa Healy are the openers for Australia Women. Jahanara Alam to start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...
Right then! 136 is what Australia Women have to chase and given how their batters are performing, this should be a cakewalk for them. We will be back with the chase shortly. Stay tuned.

Jess Jonassen is up for a quick chat. She says this has been the toughest condition she has ever played the game in. Mentions, they just tried to utilize the conditions with the breeze involved. Adds, Ash is having an incredible outing this time around. Adds, there are pros and cons for bowling from different end but is glad that it worked in their favour. Ends with a smile across her face, as she closes the interview by saying she really enjoyed her time out on the field.

Australian pacers struggled to maintain their line and lengths at the start and in the first 10 overs the score read 40/1 but they got stranglehold of the game and in the next 20 overs they were very lethal giving away just 38 runs for 2 wickets. The bowlers continued to keep bowling tight spells and Australia were always under the control of the game. They made sure that the runs were always hard to come by and kept piling the pressure on the opponents with consistent bowling. They will now fancy their chances here and would look to enter the semis being the only undefeated team.

Bangladesh openers got off to a positive start but was short-lived as Murshida Khatun departed soon. Fargana Hoque also got out without doing much damage. Bangladesh lacked partnerships and as a result, could not get a big score. They struggled against spin vs India and it was evident here as well. They consumed far too many dots and lacked the aggressive intent that was needed. Bangladesh added a few runs at the back end of the innings. But they should've done all this way before and perhaps could have ended up having a better total on the board.

The Aussie pacers have given a nice gift to Meg Lanning on her birthday as they have restricted Bangladesh to just 135. The spinners dictated terms but their pacers also supported well and it shows why they are unstoppable in this World Cup. For Bangladesh Women, no batter could play a longer innings and struggled to even keep the scoreboard ticking. The only positive for them could be that they batted whole 43 overs in these tough conditions against Australia Women against whom they are playing their first ODI game.
Fuller, outside off. Nahida Akter guides it down to third man. They take two runs before the fielder cuts it out. Bangladesh Women end their innings at 135/6.

In the air...but safe! Fuller, on off. Salma Khatun tries to sweep it away. The ball goes to square leg off the top edge. Alyssa Healy covers a lot of ground to her left but is unable to pouch the ball in the end. They take one.
Good length, outside off. Salma Khatun fails to chase it.
Touch short, Nahida Akter flat-bats it to the right of mid off. They take one.
Full length, Nahida Akter pushes it to cover.

OUT! STUMPED! Lata Mondal holes out in the final over. It is a leg-cutter, outside off. Lata Mondal dances down the track, swings her blade hard and misses it completely. Alyssa Healy gathers the ball and makes no mistake this time. Nahida Akter is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Megan Schutt

Full, around off. Lata Mondal sweeps it hard to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller, outside off. Mondal drives it to sweepr cover for a single.
Tosses it up, on off. Khatun eases it back to the bowler.
Full, on off. Salma Khatun blocks it out solidly.
Tossed up, on off. Mondal works it to long on for one.
Flatter, on off. Khatun reverse-sweeps it to third man for one.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Lata Mondal gets low and tries to sweep it away. The ball goes to fine leg off her gloves. They take one.
On off, blocked out.
It is full again. Lata Mondal sticks to her sweep shot and takes a single.
Fuller, on leg. Lata Mondal drags her sweep to deep mid-wicket.
Floated, full, on off. Salma Khatun slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Lata Mondal sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, on leg. Ashleigh Gardner sweeps it to fine leg.
Flatter, on the pads. Lata Mondal hits it to the right of the bowler.

Both the umpires converge. After a little chat. They take it upstairs. Never seen an umpire check for a bowled dismissal through UltraEdge due to no bails present. This is a first time for me.

Tossed up, full wide outside off. Salma Khatun goes for the ramp shot but fails to grab it in the end. Salma Khatun tried to be cheeky there but the ball bounced a little extra. There's a belated appeal and the umpires converge before sending it upstairs. Was it appeal for bowled? Due to strong breeze the bails were removed earlier. The ball just missed the sticks as confirmed by the UltraEdge. That missed the sticks by a whisker.
Full, on the stumps. Salma Khatun blocks on the front foot.
This is tucked on the leg side for a single.

Flighted ball, on middle and leg. Lata Mondal sits low and looks to sweep but misses. The ball kisses her gloves and rolls to fine leg for a brace. Australia Women appeal for an LBW but the umpire says no. They do go for the review and UltraEdge shows a spike.
On off, blocked out.
Tossed up, on off. Khatun drives it to cover.
Flighted full and wide of off again, Mondal sits low and drags it on the up towards long on for a single.
Flighted outside off, Blocked out.
Tossed up, outside off. Lata Mondal looks to drag the sweep and ends up cue-ending it.

OUT! CAUGHT! Very clever play from Ashleigh Gardner! Tosses this one wider, outside off. Rumana Ahmed reaches out and looks to go for another boundary. This time she sits and lofts it to mid off without any timing. Jess Jonassen there pouches a simple catch.

WIDE! Short ball again but too short, on middle. Rumana Ahmed leaves it alone. Wide called for height.
Short again, on middle. Mondal pulls it to deep square leg only for a run.
Full and outside off, Lata Mondal chases it and plays it to cover but not in the gap though.
Fuller in length, on off. Modal squezes it out to mid on.
Short ball, on middle. Pulled straight to square leg.
Back of a length, on off. Mondal cuts it to cover.
Full and down leg, Lata Mondal looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off her pads to fine leg for a leg bye.
Another dot! Length ball, on middle. Mondal shapes up for a pull but gets herself in all sorts of tangle. She can only chop it back into the pitch as a result.

Full and on the pads. Mondal clips it to short fine leg.
In-slanter, on off. Mondal blocks it out.
Length ball, on off. Mondal pushes it back to the bowler.

Well fielded! Short ball, on middle. Lata Mondal pulls it well to deep mid-wicket. Ashleigh Gardner gives it a chase and pulls the ball back in just about time. Three taken!
A yorker, on off. Rumana Ahmed jams her bat down and the rolls to the leg side for a single.
Short ball, on middle and leg. Mondal pulls it through square leg for a single.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to the off side.
Length, outside off. Ahmed dabs it to cover-point.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fuller in length, outside off. Rumana Ahmed drives it through covers nicely and gets a boundary. They need more of these!
On off, Ahmed presses forward and defends.
On a length, around off. Rumana Ahmed taps it to point off the back foot.
Full and on off, driven towards covers.
Good-length ball, on middle. Rumana Ahmed stays back and defends.

Drinks! Australia Women in firm control of the game at the moment. The runs are hardly coming by for Bangladesh Women and they need to change gears now. Australia Women meanwhile would look to continue bowling tight spells and try to restrict them somehwere around 130.
Good length, on off. Lata Mondal taps it to point.
WIDE! Length ball, down leg. Lata Mondal leaves it alone. Wide called.
This is short, outside off. Lata Mondal is not able to deal with the pace here and hence is finding it difficult to time her shots. She slashes and misses yet again.
Length ball, outside off. Lata Mondal misses her attempt to push it away.
FOUR! Nicely played! On a length, outside off. Lata Mondal plays it late, uses the pace of the ball and guides it down the third man for a boundary.
Fuller, wide outside off. Lata Mondal slashes but fails to get any bat on the ball.
On a length, outside off. Mondal defends it to mid off.
A maiden now for Megan Schutt. Touch short, outside off. Rumana Ahmed taps it to the off side. Bangladesh Women have only managed to score 15 runs in the last 10 overs.
Five dots in a row! Fuller, on leg stump. Rumana Ahmed flicks it to mid on.
Full length, angled into the pads. Ahmed defends it out solidly.
Good length, outside off. Ahmed leaves it alone for the keeper.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Rumana Ahmed works it to the leg side.
Full length, outside off. Rumana Ahmed eases it to mid off.
FOUR! First boundary in 12 overs for Bangladesh Women. Full length, outside off. Lata Mondal carves it through point for a boundary.
WIDE! It is short, outside off. Mondal leaves it alone. The umpire deems it as a wide.
On a length, outside off. Lata Mondal only manages to connect with thin air.
Back of a length, outside off. Rumana Ahmed cuts it past backward point for a single.
Fuller, around off. Rumana Ahmed digs it out to cover.
WIDE! Short ball this time, outside off, shaping away. The umpire signals a wide.
Full, on the stumps. Rumana Ahmed defends it back to the bowler.
Shortish, outside off. Rumana Ahmed tries to chase it but fails to connect.
Tossed up, on off, Mondal blocks it to point.
On off, defended to cover.

Chance goes abegging! It is tossed up, around middle and leg. Lata Mondal skips down the track, throws her blade at it and misses it completely. Alyssa Healy fails to grab the ball behind the sticks. If she would've, Lata Mondal was gone by a huge margin.
Full, outside off. Lata Mondal defends it to cover on the front foot.
Fuller, sliding down leg. Lata Mondal sweeps it straight to the square leg fielder.
Angled into the pads. Lata Mondal clips it to square leg.
Back of a length, on the fourth stump line. Rumana Ahmed tries to slap it away. The ball though zips past the outside edge.
Short ball, on middle and off. Rumana Ahmed sways away from the line of the delivery.
Fuller, on the pads. Rumana Ahmed flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Full length, on middle and leg. Rumana Ahmed defends it out watchfully.
Back of a length, outside off. Rumana Ahmed leaves it alone for the keeper.
BEATEN! Good length, outside off. Rumana Ahmed tries to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Slower through the air, on middle. Mondal defends it out.
Full and outside off, poked to point.
Lata Mondal uses her feet and drags this full one to silly mid on.
Flatter ball, sliding down leg. Rumana Ahmed sweeps it nicely to short fine leg. Tahlia McGrath does well to dive and stop the ball. Keeps it down to a single.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter, on off. Blocked out.
Fuller in length, on off. Mondal drives it to mid off.
Good-length ball, on middle. Mondal defends it back to the bowler.
Short ball, outside off. Lata Mondal lets it for the keeper to collect.
Rumana Ahmed finally gets off the mark after facing 14 deliveries. Outside off, on a length. Ahmed guides it to third man for a single.
Full again, on middle. Rumana Ahmed covers the line and blocks.
Fuller, outside off. Ahmed drives it to cover.
Nice and full, sliding down leg. Lata Mondal shapes for a flick but hits it off the splice to the off side. Another wicket maiden for Jess Jonassen!
Loopy ball, on off. Mondal defends it watchfully.
Full and on middle, Lata Mondal blocks it out.
Lata Mondal is the new batter in.

Nigar Sultana kneels and goes for the sweep only to get a top edge that falls right into the bucket hands of Tahlia McGrath at square leg.
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Jess Jonassen

Nigar Sultana drives this full ball towards covers.
A maiden from Alana King! Australia Women keeping it very tight and under control. Sliding down leg, Rumana Ahmed gets hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, driven towards covers.
Full and on off, patted back to the bowler again.
Floats it up, on the stumps. Rumana Ahmed defends it back.
Full and on leg, pushed back to the bowler again.

On the pads, Sultana defends it out.
WIDE! Full and down leg, going in with the arm. Wided.
Flatter ball, on leg. Sultana clips it on the leg side.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover.
On off, blocked out.
Full and given some loop, outside off. Sultana drives it to cover.
Flatter, on the pads. Nigar Sultana flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Shortish, on off. Nigar Sultana defends it into the deck.

Fuller, on leg. Nigar Sultana drags her sweep to fine leg for a brace.
On middle and leg, blocked out.

Angles it into the pads. Rumana Ahmed blocks it to mid on.
On off, defended out.
On middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.

Bangladesh Women have opted for an LBW review. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat so no probelm there. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching in line, the impact is in line and it is wickets hitting. The original decision stands.

OUT! LBW! Bangladesh Women lose a review along with the wicket of Sharmin Akhter. Jess Jonassen now gets herself into the wicket's column. It is a flighted delivery, full, around middle and leg. Sharmin Akhter tries to defend it out but misses. The ball goes through to hit her on the pads. Jess Jonassen appeals and the umpire agrees instantly. Sharmin Akhter has a chat with her skipper and takes the review. Although, the Ball Tracking confirms three reds and Sharmin Akhter has to trudge back to the pavilion.
Length, on off. Nigar Sultana eases it back to the bowler.
On a length, outside off. Nigar Sultana defends it to point.
Length ball, on the stumps. Nigar Sultana blocks it to point watchfully.
WIDE! Full length, sliding down leg. Nigar Sultana tries to flick it away but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
A short ball, on the bodyline. Nigar Sultana ducks under it.
This is a full toss, on off. Nigar Sultana pushes it down the ground for two more runs.
Full length, outside off. Nigar Sultana carves it through covers for a brace.

Tossed up, on off. Sharmin Akhter defends it to the leg side off the inner half.
Fuller, outside off. Sharmin Akhter prods and defends it out.

Short ball, on the pads. Sharmin Akhter pulls it behind square on the leg side. The batters run two comfortably.
Short ball, on off. Nigar Sultana sways away from the line of the delivery.
Back of a length, outside off, left alone.
Full toss, on off. Nigar Sultana hits it to mid on, but not into the gap.
A sharp bouncer, on off. Nigar Sultana sways away from the line of the deliver.

Well done, Heals! Really, really, kind gesture from Australia's wicketkeeper, Alyssa Healy. When Nigar Sultana came out to bat, she was marking her guard at the batting crease. Normally, when batters select the guard, they are helped by the umpire. But at that point of time, neither of the two umpires were present near the stumps. To help poor Nigar out, Alyssa quickly ran up to the stumps at the other end and helped her mark her guard! Wow, really good sportsmanship.
Good-length ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter gets it to third man off the outside edge. They take one.
Length ball, on fourth stump. Sharmin Akhter defends it to point.
Floats it up, on middle. Nigar Sultana turns it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Loopy ball down leg, Nigar Sultana leaves it alone. Wided. 50 up for Bangladesh Women with that extra!
Short and on off, Sultana hangs back and pulls it to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover.
Tossed up, outside off. Sultana blocks it out.
Loopy ball down leg, Sharmin Akhter looks to sweep. The ball goes off the top edge past short fine leg for a single.
Flatter, outside off. Akhter drives it to point.
Full and on the pads, Nigar Sultana fails to clip that.

DRINKS! After marking the second-highest opening stand against Australia in this World Cup. Bangladesh Women could not continue their good work, as after losing the first wicket, the Australian bowler mounted the pressure with many dot balls. Bangladesh Women need to focus on stitching a solid partnership and make sure to have a good score on the board. Australia Women, on the flip side, would be eyeing to pick up wickets at regular intervals. Nigar Sultana is the new batter in for Bangladesh Women.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The short ball plan works for Australia Women! Short ball again from Annabel Sutherland on middle and leg, Fargana Hoque again goes for the pull shot. This time it goes off the edge towards the keeper and Alyssa Healy does not make any mistake. Annabel Sutherland strikes in her first over and Bangladesh Women lose their second wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Alyssa Healy b Annabel Sutherland

Short ball, on off. Fargana Hoque waits for it and pulls it through mid-wicket without much control. She gets two!
Length ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter guides it to deep backward point for a single.
Change. Annabel Sutherland comes into the attack now for Australia Women.
A maiden from Ashleigh Gardner! Shortish, outside off. Fargana Hoque cuts it to point.
On middle and leg, Fargana Hoque clips it on the leg side. She calls for a single but is sent back.
Full and outside off, Fargana Hoque defends it off the inner half of the bat back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on middle and leg. Hoque tucks it on the leg side.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Pushed to covers.
Floats it up, on off. Hoque dabs it to short third man.
On middle, nudged to square leg.
FOUR! Good shot! Full and outside off, Sharmin Akhter gets low, creates some room and blazes it powerfully into the gap between extra cover and mid-off. A boundary!
Loopy ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter looks to dab it late but misses.
Tossed up, full and on off. Akhter lunges forward to block.
Angling in from outside off, Sharmin Akhter works it to square leg.
Flatter ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter taps it to the off side.
Full and on off, worked to mid on.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Fargana Hoque goes behind and blocks it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Swept to mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it up, on off. Akhter defends it out.
Loopy ball, wide outside off, Sharmin Akhter reaches out for it and pushes it to cover.
Flatter and outside off, Sharmin Akhter looks to drive but fails to connect.
WOW! Fargana Hoque becomes the first Bangladesh Women batter to cross the 1000-run mark in ODIs. Full, outside off. Fargana Hoque gets it to third man off the outside edge. The batters take a couple.
Full, outside off. Fargana Hoque strides to defend it out.
Floated, on the pads. Fargana Hoque flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off. Fargana Hoque blocks it back to the bowler.
On off, defended out.
Fuller, on leg. Fargana Hoque defends it to the leg side.
Flatter, on leg. Fargana Hoque clips it to fine leg for one. At the end of Powerplay 1, Bangladesh Women are 38/1.
LEG BYE! Looped up, angled down leg. Sharmin Akhter fails to flick it away. The ball goes to fine leg off the pads. The batters cross for a leg bye.
Full, on the pads. Fargana Hoque flicks it to mid-wicket for one.

Fargana Hoque is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ashleigh Gardner draws the first blood. Murshida Khatun has to walk back after a decent start. It is fuller, around middle. Murshida Khatun gets low and sweeps it to the left of short square leg. Rachael Haynes dives to her left and gathers the ball with two hands comfortably. Bangladesh Women would hope they don't see a collapse now!
Commentary.Howout: c Rachael Haynes b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Full, outside off. Sharmin Akhter blocks it to the off side. Jess Jonassen goes for only three runs in her first over.
On the pads, defended to mid-wicket.
Good running! Fuller, on the stumps. Murshida Khatun pushes it gently to covers and gets across for a quick single.
Angled into the pads. Sharmin Akhter tries to defend on her front foot. The ball goes to square leg off the inner half. They take a single.
Full, outside off. Murshida Khatun drives it to cover for a single.
On off, blocked out.

Tosses it up, on off. Sharmin Akhter tries to carve it through the off side. The ball though takes the inside edge, scoots past the stumps. They take a single.
Touch flat again, on the stumps. Sharmin Akhter blocks it back to the bowler.
Flatter, on off. Sharmin Akhter blocks it out.
Short, on off. Murshida Khatun squares up and defends it to the off side.

WIDE! On a length, down the leg side. Murshida Khatun leaves it alone. Wide called.
LEG BYE! A length ball, angled down leg. Sharmin Akhter fails to flick it away. It brushes the pads and goes towards fine leg. They cross for a leg bye.

Darcie Brown appeals but the umpire is unmoved. This time though, Meg Lanning takes the review. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking confirms that the ball is missing the wickets. Australia Women lose an early review here.

Full length, on fourth stump. Murshida Khatun drives it to the left of point. The fielder makes a half-stop. The batters cross for a single.

Good-length ball, moving away, outside off. Sharmin Akhter presses forward to defend but misses.

Good length, on off. Akhter blocks it to the off side.
On a length, on off. Sharmin Akhter punches it towards covers.
Length ball, on middle. Sharmin Akhter defends it watchfully.

Length ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter offers no shot.
WIDE! A bumper down leg, Sharmin Akhter sits under it. Wided.
Length ball, on leg. Sharmin Akhter looks to tuck but misses. She gets hit on the thigh pads. Appeal from behind for an LBW but that was going down leg.
Good-length ball, on middle. Murshida Khatun taps it with soft hands to extra cover for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Khatun plays it nicely but straight to point.
Length, on off. Khatun pushes it to point.
Full and outside off, just inside the tramline. Sharmin Akhter lets it go.
Length ball, coming in, on middle. Sharmin Akhter is caught in her crease and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Back of a length, outside off. Sharmin Akhter pushes it to point.
Length ball, outside off. Murshida Khatun pushes it through covers and crosses ends.
Wider line, Sharmin Akhter pushes hard at it. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for one.
Beauty! Good-length ball, cross-seam delivery. Hits the length and goes just over the stumps. Sharmin Akhter defeated all ends up there!
And again! Good length, outside off. Sharmin Akhter tries to drive and the ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a single.
Extra bounce! Short of a length, around off. Sharmin Akhter is surprised by the bounce and the ball just whizzes past her gloves.

It is quite windy here in Wellington. In that game against India, Australia had a shocker with the ball, conceding more than 30 wides. A good test for them again today, ahead of the first semifinal which will be played at this very ground on Wednesday.
Length ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter lets it be.
Outside off, on a length. Murshida Khatun looks to drive. The ball goes off the outside edge past the slip cordon again and rolls down to third man for a run.
Fullish and outside off, Murshida Khatun lets it sail through.
WIDE! Length ball down leg, Murshida Khatun looks to glance it but misses. Wided.
Clever from Brown! Sees Murshida Khatun stepping out and bowls a short ball, on middle and leg. Murshida Khatun looks to pull but misses.

NO BALL! Length ball, on off. Sanjida Akter looks to defend off the back foot. The ball catches the outside edge and flies past the slip cordon for a single. Darcie Brown has overstepped and will have to reload.
It will be Darcie Brown to steam in from the other end.
On a length, on off. Sharmin Akhter goes back to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a run.
Sharmin Akhter gets off the mark as well! Full and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Length ball, wide outside off. Enough for the umpire to call it as a wide.
On a good length, on off. Sharmin Akhter blocks it from the crease.
Beaten! Good-length ball, shaping in, outside off. Sharmin Akhter looks to defend but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Good-length ball, outside off, Sharmin Akhter lets it go. Megan Schutt testing the outside edge there.
Murshida Khatun and Bangladesh Women are underway! Megan Schutt starts with a length ball, on leg. Murshida Khatun clips it to square leg and sets off for a single.

Done with all the pre-match proceedings! The Australia Women players take the field now. Followed by Murshida Khatun and Sharmin Akhter who walk out to open for Bangladesh Women. Australia form a huddle and show their support to the BLM movement, while the Bangladesh players take the knee. Megan Schutt to start with the new ball. A reminder that, 3 bowlers can bowl 9 overs, while 2 bowlers will have 8 overs each in the bank.

We are set for the clash at the Basin Reserve. Both the teams first stride out to the middle. They get lined-up on the field for their respective national anthems. It will be Australia's first, followed by the one of Bangladesh.

Ellyse Perry is in for a chat. She says that she is feeling better. Mentions that she will recover in the next couple of days. Tells that it's a wonderful opportunity for the girls to perform against Bangladesh as they haven't played an ODI game with them before.

PITCH REPORT - Leslie Murdoch says that the pitch has been under the covers for 18 hours. Mentions there is going to be some swing and it will bring the moisture into play. Tells that there is going to be some bounce as well and it is going to be a tough ask for the Bangladeshi batters.

Nigar Sultana, the Bangladesh Women skipper, is in for a chat. She says they aim to bounce back as a batting unit. Mentions, they are ready for the big test. Ends by saying she has no changes to inform about.

Meg Lanning, the Australian skipper says that they will bowl first. On receiving the birthday wishes, she says that she does feel old. Mentions that these are different conditions and they will look to adapt them quickly. Informs that they have got one change. Darcie Brown comes in for Perry.

Bangladesh Women (Unchanged playing XI) - Sharmin Akhter, Murshida Khatun, Fargana Hoque, Nigar Sultana (C/ WK), Rumana Ahmed, Ritu Moni, Lata Mondal, Salma Khatun, Fahima Khatun, Nahida Akter, Jahanara Alam.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Rachael Haynes, Alyssa Healy (WK), Meg Lanning (C), Darcie Brown (In for Ellyse Perry), Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath, Ashleigh Gardner, Annabel Sutherland, Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Megan Schutt.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Australia Women. They have opted to bowl first.

Update 0426 IST (2256 GMT, previous day) - Woah! We have some good news coming your way. The covers are off the field. The toss is being scheduled to happen at 0500 IST (2330 GMT, previous day) with the game to begin at 0530 IST (0000 GMT). Lets keep our fingers crossed and hope the rain gods show some mercy. Also, if we get going as per the new timings. The match has been reduced to 43 overs each with 9 Powerplay overs.

Update 0402 IST (2232 GMT, previous day) - Wellington hasn’t witnessed heavy rainfall since the last 30 minutes. It has stopped raining for a while now with some strong breeze across the ground. This should help to push away some dark clouds. If the conditions remain to be the same, we shall be back soon with the game heading in the right direction. Stay tuned for more updates.
Update 0353 IST (2223 GMT, previous day) - It looks like an inspection will take place at 0400 IST (2230 GMT, previous day). Lets hope we could squeeze in a game in this wet weather.

The first semifinal is scheduled to be played here and Australia will feature in that. Hopefully, the weather holds good and all but the important thing is that there is a reserve day for all the three knockout games. We also witnessed a rare rearguard action. England were 114/9 but two tailenders have taken them to 204 at Stumps on Day 1 of the third WI-Eng Test, which indicates that in all likelihood, this match will have a result.

Update - 0258 IST (2128 GMT, previous day) - It ain't a good sight. After only 10.5 overs being bowled in a over reduced match between South Africa and West Indies, the story remains to be the same at Wellington. We are greeted by the rain again. Let us hope it is just a passing shower and we get some action soon. Inevitably, the toss has been delayed. The covers are firmly placed over the wicket. Stay tuned for more updates.

Bangladesh Women on the other hand, have put on a spirited show in the World Cup so far. After beating Pakistan, the Tigresses gave the West Indies a run for their money. However, they lost to India by a huge margin. Against a formidable side like Australia, Bangladesh will have to be at their best to even come close to winning. Will Australia stay unbeaten? Or will Bangladesh stun everyone? We shall find out. Stick around for the toss and team news.

The Aussies have been unstoppable in this mega event and are the team to beat. They are already assured of a top-two finish but they would be keen to continue their winning streak going into the knockouts. In their previous encounter, the Aussies produced a clinical performance against South Africa and defeated the Proteas with five wickets to spare. Ellyse Perry is going to miss this match but Meg Lanning has plethora of options available to replace her and since they have already qualified, she might be keen to make a few changes and test the bench strength.

We are almost at the business end of the Women's Cricket World Cup and in match 25, we will see Australia Women take on Bangladesh Women. Both teams have experienced contrasting fortunes in the mega event. Australia would go into this game as the firm favourites but Bangladesh have been vibrant in their approach. A cracking game beckons at Basin Reserve. On that note, welcome to the coverage.
